info.title: vvvv-mcp
info.description: MCP server for vvvv gamma. Builds whole connected patch subgraphs in one call (build_patch) verified against the live instance; live node registry with exact pins + real types (19k nodes) via the VL.MCP.HDE editor extension; offline catalog fallback; Gray Book knowledge base; C# node + SDSL shader generation. Works without a vvvv installation for knowledge and patch tools.
